about: Vectors for the three readings of the wallet binding in an ERC-8004 feedback grounding (erc-8004/erc-8004-contracts#99). Expected verdicts per reading were written first by predge-ai (comment 6397094496); case 1 is also recorded live on Base Sepolia. Run: npx -y agent-receipt-verify ground --feedback=<tx> --network=eip155:84532
credit: predge-ai (expected verdicts and the two original cases)

readings.payment_block: fact 2 read at the block of the payment (paidIsBoundWalletAtPayment)
readings.feedback_block: fact 2 read at the block of the feedback (paidIsBoundWallet)
readings.now: the binding as it stands at the latest block (binding.agentWalletNu), with koppelingVeranderd when it differs from the feedback block

timeline: B2 payer P pays W1 (USDC transfer)
B4 P calls giveFeedback, feedbackHash = payment transaction

live.replay: vectors/grounding/predge-geval1-agent-10402.json, a recording of the real Base Sepolia chain replayed offline by: npx -y agent-receipt-verify ground --vectors

expected.payment_block: not grounded (no binding yet, reported as payment before registration)
